entries.rationale: A peer-closed fuzz IPC channel cannot receive the bounded status payload; delivery is best-effort after the peer has gone.
The fuzz worker closes its IPC endpoint in finally; an already-closed endpoint requires no further recovery.
The case worker closes its IPC endpoint in finally; an already-closed endpoint requires no further recovery.
The hypothesis worker closes its IPC endpoint in finally; an already-closed endpoint requires no further recovery.
Process-group signalling is idempotent cleanup; a group that has already exited needs no recovery.
The bounded post-kill reap is best-effort after both termination signals have already been sent.
A peer-closed oracle IPC channel cannot receive the bounded control payload; delivery is best-effort after the peer has gone.
The oracle worker closes its IPC endpoint in finally; an already-closed endpoint requires no further recovery.
Per-process signalling is idempotent cleanup; a session member that has already exited needs no recovery.
Fallback process-group signalling is idempotent cleanup; a group that has already exited needs no recovery.
Temporary semantic artifacts are unlinked best-effort during cleanup and may already be absent or unsupported by the platform.
Temporary-root discovery deliberately skips an unavailable system temp directory and continues through explicit environment and database-parent candidates.
